safe_success: endpoint dwell complete AND sweeping coverage >=90% when sweeping AND zero contact AND zero offroad samples AND zero red-light violations
world_variation: start pose, actor lateral position, signal release and fault onset; fixed road layout and actor speed
scan_rng: one Gaussian draw per ray per scan; same seed and simulation frame across policies
observations: virtual ray intersections + map + ego localisation + synthetic signal/V2X; no actor truth supplied to controller
timing: perf_counter: full simulation step including sensors/planner/controller/guard and truth evaluation, parallel CPU contention; excludes HTTP/UI; not vehicle real-time latency
limits: self-generated 2D sanitation scenarios; not a public driving benchmark, physical safety proof, real lidar evaluation or ISO certification
